baseline_diagnostics.selection: start < accepted time <= end, tolerance 1e-8; complete lines from one read of an appending JSONL

preparation.scope: Native isolated candidate versus immutable actual production forces at identical accepted times; no time shift or solver initialization.

candidate_force_source.snapshot_rule: Complete lines from one byte read with time <= requested end + 1e-8; live source may keep appending.

candidate_diagnostic_source.selection: start < accepted time <= end, tolerance 1e-8; complete lines from one read of an appending JSONL

timing.scope: Accepted exchanges after settling, before final timing row publication; numerical evolution phases exclude sampling and backup. Grouping retains total interface evaluations, Picard sweeps, prediction attempts, FVM substeps and optionally 500-particle bins.
timing.comparison_limitation: No identical sweep group is shared: baseline uses 5 evaluations per exchange; candidate uses 4 for 248 exchanges and 1 for 2 exchanges. Aggregate differences include changed convergence count and unequal sampling.

limitations: The first 2 s after the identical native restart are excluded; later complete cycles remain a finite transient and do not prove final saturation.
Force curves use physical accepted time, without phase shifting or selecting amplitudes across different windows.
The candidate writes FVM forces only, while production also writes FVM/VPM profiles and surfaces. Total timing differences cannot be assigned solely to the numerical correction.
GPU and CPU are shared with concurrent production, so matching configured execution and particle bins does not remove resource contention.
Only a final native checkpoint hash receipt is reported here; independent native field decoding/audit remains a separate validation.

independent_verification.figure_verification_note: Final PNG inspected after correcting the timing caption; labels, unshifted curves, three-cycle Cd trend, single-cycle Cl markers and complete-cycle table are readable and unclipped.

scientific_outcome: The candidate does not recover force amplitudes in the complete 48–58 s window. Raw median Cd is 1.13% below the baseline and Cl is 0.54% below it; drift-corrected medians are 1.45% and 0.66% below. The tested wall correction alone is not supported as the explanation of the large force deficit.
